The standard formula for the determinant of a 3x3 matrix is:
$det = m_{00}(m_{11}m_{22} - m_{12}m_{21}) - m_{01}(m_{10}m_{22} - m_{12}m_{20}) + m_{02}(m_{10}m_{21} - m_{11}m_{20})$

           m[0][2] * (m[1][0] * m[2][1] - m[1][1] * m[2][0]);
